about.title: About Me
about.heading: Understanding systems, building better experiences
about.content1: I focus on analyzing how game systems shape player behavior, pacing, and long-term engagement. Through case studies, system breakdowns, and technical projects, I explore the intersection of game design logic and practical implementation.
about.content2: My work spans gameplay analysis, system design thinking, and hands-on development. I care about how ideas are translated into rules, interfaces, and user-facing experiences that people can actually feel.
about.content3: This website is a collection of my work in game systems, design thinking, and technical experimentation. It is where I organize ongoing research, notes, and selected projects.
